Record Class MoleculePresentation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.MoleculePresentation
Record Components:
heiVisible - whether to list the molecule in HEI
creativeVisible - whether to list its generated sample in creative tabs
tooltips - whether associated items may show molecule previews
worldHud - whether blocks and fluids may show molecule previews
polymerPreviewUnits - initial linear-polymer examiner length; zero uses the authored default
tags - molecule grouping IDs, separate from item/fluid binding tags
heiItemSlot - explicit HEI item-slot choice, or null to use the player preference
public record MoleculePresentation(boolean heiVisible, boolean creativeVisible, boolean tooltips, boolean worldHud, int polymerPreviewUnits, Set<String> tags, Boolean heiItemSlot) extends Record
Controls where a molecule appears without deleting its definition or changing its chemistry. Server pack rules supply these values; a player's disabled tooltip/HUD options still take precedence over an enabled preview here.

      heiVisible - whether HEI lists the molecule
